paragraphs: Ibec is a group for Irish businesses. It says the Irish economy will grow faster next year.
It looks at spending by people, companies and the Government in Ireland. Ibec thinks this spending will grow by 4% next year. This year, it will grow by about 3.5%.
More people will have jobs too. Almost 2.9 million people could be working next year. That would be a new record.
But there are some problems. Energy prices go up and down. Interest rates are rising. US taxes on imports are hurting Irish exports.
Still, Ibec says Irish families have good savings. Companies are also spending more on computers and AI. This should help the economy stay strong.
sentZh: Ibec 是一個代表愛爾蘭企業的團體。
它說愛爾蘭經濟明年會成長得更快。
它關注的是愛爾蘭國內民眾、企業和政府的支出。
Ibec 認為這項支出明年會成長 4%。
今年大約會成長 3.5%。
有工作的人也會更多。
明年可能有將近 290 萬人在工作。
那將創下新紀錄。
但也有一些問題。
能源價格忽高忽低。
利率正在上升。
美國對進口商品課稅，正打擊愛爾蘭的出口。
儘管如此，Ibec 說愛爾蘭家庭有不錯的儲蓄。
企業也在電腦和人工智慧上花更多錢。
這應有助於經濟保持強勁。

paragraphs: Ibec, the main group that speaks for Irish businesses, says the Irish economy at home will grow faster next year, even though energy prices are unstable and interest rates are going up.

Ibec measures domestic demand, which means spending in Ireland by people, businesses and the Government. It does not include the big effects of multinational companies. Ibec says domestic demand will grow by 4% next year, up from about 3.5% this year.
The number of people with jobs is also expected to rise to almost 2.9 million next year, which would be a new record. At the end of June, 2.84 million people were working.
However, GDP, the wider measure of the economy, is expected to fall by 0.8% this year. This is because US tariffs have caused problems for Irish exports.

Ibec says families have high savings and companies are in a strong position. Spending on digital equipment linked to AI has also grown quickly, and this should help protect Ireland from problems abroad.
sentZh: 代表愛爾蘭企業的主要團體 Ibec 表示，儘管能源價格不穩、利率上升，愛爾蘭國內經濟明年仍會成長得更快。
Ibec 衡量的是國內需求，也就是民眾、企業和政府在愛爾蘭的支出。
它不包含跨國企業帶來的巨大影響。
Ibec 說國內需求明年將成長 4%，高於今年的約 3.5%。
有工作的人數預計明年也將增至將近 290 萬，創下新紀錄。
六月底時，有 284 萬人在工作。
不過，衡量經濟較廣的指標 GDP 預計今年將下降 0.8%。
這是因為美國關稅給愛爾蘭出口帶來了問題。
Ibec 說家庭儲蓄高，企業處境穩健。
與人工智慧相關的數位設備支出也快速成長，這應有助於保護愛爾蘭免受海外問題衝擊。

paragraphs: Irish domestic demand is on course to grow by 4% next year despite volatile energy prices and rising interest rates, according to the latest economic outlook from the business group Ibec.

Domestic demand, which strips out the distorting effect of multinational companies, is expected to grow by about 3.5% this year. Ibec's chief economist, Gerard Brady, said the real domestic economy remained in very solid shape.

Employment is forecast to approach a record 2.9 million next year, up from 2.84 million at the end of June. By contrast, headline GDP is projected to fall by 0.8% this year as US tariffs disrupt exports.

The group pointed to high household savings, strong company balance sheets and investment under the National Development Plan as key supports. Business spending on digital equipment has climbed to nearly 2.5% of national income, compared with about 1% two years ago, driven by the global boom in artificial intelligence.
